name: Gen 1 Glitch Preservation Project
description: G1GPP MissingNo. Trainer OAM/BG handoff probe. Preserves the validated 12.13.43 enemy/player corruption and renders the inverted Trainer as a reversed-column+nibble-swapped BG body plus a temporary normal-column nibble-swapped 3-row head overlay during the native intro slide; the overlay disappears at the engine handoff.
